v03Ops.lead: Load a passport by Passport ID. If you received ownership by transfer, your wallet will not appear under “Your passports” (that list is minted-by-this-wallet only) — paste the ID here. On-chain governance is a single address (often a multisig or Safe); there is no built-in multisig bytecode.
v03Ops.creator: Creator (issuer wallet)
v03Ops.revokedYes: Yes — do not treat as valid.
v03Ops.publishAgentHint: One wallet may update hosted URLs (updatePassportUrls) for all passports you minted. Set or revoke it from the issuer wallet; it is not per-passport.
v03Ops.agentUrlLead: Load the passport above first. As the issuer’s active publishing agent you may change only primary dataUrl and imageUrl (not image 2/3 on-chain). Hashes stay immutable.
v03Ops.agentUrlUrlTooLong: Each URL must be at most 512 characters.
v03Ops.pAffLead: Parent must be a P-type profile. Full propose / confirm flows stay on Profile.
v03Ops.needChildP: Enter the child P Profile ID.
v03Ops.notV03: This registry is not v0.3 — these actions are unavailable.

pmProof.calloutBody: This flow answers a request to confirm something about one passport that is already in the registry. You attach your institution’s on-chain proof to that Passport ID only — you are not minting a new passport here.
pmProof.body: After a client or partner gives you the Passport ID, you can record your expert / institutional confirmation on-chain. Optional: hash of a PDF (or other file) and a public link. Gas only; your profile ID is stored as the prover.
pmProof.mintFootnote: To mint new passports, open “Mint or update passports” below. P and M tiers have no monthly C/B mint cap.
pmProof.humanIdHint: The passport must already exist on-chain (minted by anyone). If the ID is wrong or not minted, the contract will reject the transaction.
pmProof.noteFileHelp: Upload a certificate, report, or scan — we compute SHA-256 in the browser; only the hash is sent on-chain.
pmProof.noteFileDrop2: Hashed locally — file is not uploaded to this site
pmProof.noteUrlHint: Use only if you also uploaded a file: the contract stores URL and hash together.
pmProof.listEmpty: No attestations recorded for your profile yet.
pmProof.needHumanId: Enter a valid Passport ID (starts with ODP-).
pmProof.urlNeedsHash: To use a link, upload a file first so a note hash is set (required by the contract).

form.physicalDesc: Artwork, photography, documents, collectibles — any physical object with a seal
form.extraMetaHint: Optional key–value fields included in passport.json and hashed on-chain (e.g. inventory number, accession, exhibition). Keys must be non-empty to be stored.
form.skipPublicUrl: No public file URL — mint with an empty on-chain dataUrl. The public Verify page cannot fetch your passport from the web; detailed checks require a local passport file or an .odp bundle. You can add a URL later via Update hosting URLs.
form.useFolder: Use a folder on my site — after mint, the app registers a path like …/YourPassportID.json automatically (one extra confirm in the wallet)
form.folderHint: No filename — just the folder. After mint, upload your passport file named ODP-YYYY-MM-NNNNNNNNN.json (your real Passport ID from the success screen, same casing). The on-chain dataUrl will be your-folder/ODP-….json.
form.fullUrlHint: Exact public HTTPS URL of the file after you upload it. Use this if you already know the full path (without using the folder option above).
form.hostingInfoTitleFull: How third-party passport file hosting works
form.digitalWarn: ⚠ Register BEFORE sharing the original. Publish only compressed or watermarked versions after.
form.fdropFileLine1: Drop original file or click to select
form.fdropImgLine1: Drop image or click to select
form.sealLead: A seal binds this passport to the specific physical object. At least one method required.
form.nfcLead: Protocol + contract: NTAG424DNA_TT (NXP NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper) only. Non–TagTamper chips cannot be minted.
form.feeLine: This deployment (on-chain gen {gen}): Polygon gas (POL) only — no separate protocol fee. Typical ~US$0.01 (varies).
form.preModalTitle: Your passport file — confirm before minting
form.preWithUrlP1: The chain stores only a hash of your passport — not the full JSON. You must keep the canonical passport.json and host it at the dataUrl you register. If the file is missing or bytes differ from the hash, verification cannot succeed (see SPEC.md §9–§11).
form.preWithUrlP2: After mint you get a .odp bundle. For your registered HTTPS path, unzip once and upload passport.json (same canonical bytes as in the bundle) to match dataUrl — e.g. …/YourPassportID.json. You can update the URL later on-chain (gas only) via Update hosting URLs.
form.preSkipUrlP1: You are minting without a public JSON URL (empty on-chain dataUrl). The Verify page will not be able to load or compare your passport from the network — the record is useless for public online checks until you add a URL later.
form.preSkipUrlP2: Only someone who holds your .odp bundle (or the passport.json inside it) can check details and authenticity (hash vs dataHash). Keep the bundle safe and share it deliberately.
form.preAckWithUrl: I understand: I must keep the .odp bundle and host passport.json (from inside it) at the registered URL if I want public HTTP verification. Without those bytes at the URL, others cannot verify via the web.
form.preAckSkipUrl: I understand: without a public JSON URL, the Verify page cannot load my file from the web; only people with my .odp bundle (or its passport.json) can check details and authenticity against the on-chain hash.
form.preAckErr: Check the box to confirm you understand, then continue.
form.hostingModalP1: If you use folder hosting in the form, the app registers your-folder/YourPassportID.json for you after mint. Otherwise, paste the full file URL yourself.
form.hostingModalP2: The verifier loads your URL in the browser (same as opening the link). The response must be the raw JSON bytes of the passport — not an HTML page, not a login wall, not a pretty-printed GitHub file view.
form.hostingModalP3: HTTPS is required. Use a direct file URL that returns status 200 with the file body (e.g. application/json or plain text).
form.hostingModalP4: GitHub: use the Raw URL (raw.githubusercontent.com/… or Raw button), not the repository HTML page. After pushing, wait until the raw link shows your file.
form.hostingModalP5: Your site / CDN: unzip your .odp and upload passport.json unchanged to any static host (object storage, Netlify, Vercel, nginx, …). The path in the URL must match where you actually put the file.
form.hostingModalP6: CORS: verification runs in the browser; the host must allow cross-origin GET from the verifier page (many public static hosts and GitHub Raw do; a misconfigured private server may block the request).
form.hostingModalP7: Bytes = truth: any change to whitespace or characters changes the SHA-256. Upload the exact passport.json from your .odp bundle unless you use tooling that reproduces the same canonical minified JSON.
form.hostingModalP8: Alternatively, you may upload the whole .odp file to your HTTPS URL (path ending in .odp). The Verify page will unzip it in the browser and read passport.json — same hash rules as raw JSON.
form.urlModalLead: Change where passport.json and the optional image are hosted. Only the creator wallet can submit. dataHash on-chain stays the same — the file at the new URL must still match that hash. You only pay Polygon network gas (POL) in your wallet.
form.urlDataUrlLabel: Passport JSON URL (optional — leave empty to clear public URL)
form.validateFolderUrl: Enter a valid HTTPS folder URL (e.g. https://art.com/passport)
form.validateDigitalFile: Original file is required for digital objects
form.validateNfc: NFC chip UID and public key are required
form.validateSeal: Seal number and type are required
form.mintConfirmWallet: Please confirm the transaction in your wallet
form.mintUrlFail: Mint succeeded, but updating the public file URL failed. Use URLs next to this passport in the list below and set the JSON URL to:
form.mintReadHumanId: Could not read Passport ID from mint receipt.
form.successShareCaption: Open Share to get a QR, the link, download the image, or send via your device.
form.successUploadWithUrl: Unzip your .odp once, then upload passport.json unchanged to this exact HTTPS URL (same bytes → hash matches dataHash):
form.successNoPublicUrl: No public JSON URL is registered on-chain. Share the downloaded .odp only with people who must verify — they can check the bundle (passport.json inside) against dataHash. You can add a URL later via Update hosting URLs.
form.successStep2: Use Share: QR encodes odp:// + Passport ID (SPEC).
form.successStep3: Make sure your profile ID {creatorId} is published on your website and social profiles.
form.successIphoneHint: iPhone / MetaMask in-app browser: a plain download may not appear in Files. Use Share .odp (Save to Files / iCloud), then unzip and upload passport.json to your host unchanged.
form.successDidHint: Optional off-chain JSON for did:odp — you can generate this anytime from chain data, including for older passports.
form.qrFail: QR library did not load (network / CDN blocked).
